title: Beyond the ETH envelope: exact two-resolvent fluctuation structure, projected microscopic closure, and rigid versus nonperturbative sectors
summary: Eigenstate thermalization fixes the smooth energy-resolved envelope of few-body observables but not the microscopic overlap statistics that realize it. In the multi-resolvent hierarchy, this missing information appears in a two-resolvent fluctuation sector. We solve that sector exactly in a tractable benchmark, random free fermions, obtaining a non-Porter-Thomas intensity hierarchy, a structured channel-distance covariance, and an exact overlap kernel that closes the two-resolvent covariance.
